datasets.name: BCI
datasets.description: Weakly paired H&E and HER2 IHC images. Separate-dataset and pooled training are evaluated on the same frozen BCI test tiles.
datasets.notes: Original test preserved. Validation uses 15% grade-stratified training tiles. Case identity and patient independence are unverified. Native 256-pixel crops.

datasets.name: MIST
datasets.description: H&E to HER2, ER, PR and Ki67. A frozen source-group split replaces overlapping author splits.
datasets.notes: 70/15/15 source-group split across all markers. Source groups are not verified patients. Physical field of view varies.

datasets.name: IHC4BC
datasets.description: Marker-specific baselines and pooling with MIST (and BCI for HER2). All models share the same evaluation manifests.
datasets.notes: 70/15/15 source-case split, stratified by marker availability. Shared source identifiers stay together. Patient independence is unverified.

datasets.name: Finland prostate
datasets.description: 39,965 registered 1024-pixel RGB tile pairs from 81 slides, at 0.353 µm/pixel. Native 256-pixel crops for evaluation.

datasets.name: DermaRepo skin

datasets.notes: Case-disjoint split; patient identities unknown. 16 of 76 matching slides failed registration checks. Global registration leaves local deformation and focus differences.

psnr.label: PSNR
psnr.description: Peak signal-to-noise ratio from RGB pixel error, averaged per tile. Higher means less pixel error. Sensitive to registration; does not establish cell fidelity.

ssim.label: SSIM
ssim.description: Structural similarity of luminance, contrast and local structure. Windowing differs between box and scikit-image protocols. Compare within the selected protocol.

lpips.label: LPIPS
lpips.description: AlexNet Learned Perceptual Image Patch Similarity. Lower means more similar learned visual features. A natural-image perceptual measure, not a validated pathology endpoint.

mae.label: RGB MAE
mae.description: Mean absolute error between paired RGB pixels on a 0–1 scale. Lower means closer pixel values; alignment and stain intensity affect it.

delta_e76.label: ΔE76
delta_e76.description: CIE 1976 Euclidean colour difference in Lab space. Lower means closer colour. This is not CIEDE2000.

delta_e2000.label: ΔE2000
delta_e2000.description: CIEDE2000 perceptual colour difference. Measured on the fixed stain-analysis subset where configured. Lower means closer colour.

dab_od_mae.label: DAB OD MAE
dab_od_mae.description: Absolute difference in mean DAB optical density between prediction and target. Descriptive stain diagnostic; not receptor status or cell positivity.

dab_correlation.label: DAB correlation
dab_correlation.description: Correlation of predicted and target DAB optical-density summaries across tiles. A cohort diagnostic, not a per-cell score.

dab_pred_mean.label: Predicted DAB OD
dab_pred_mean.description: Mean predicted DAB optical density. Interpret beside the target mean; it has no universal best direction.

dab_target_mean.label: Target DAB OD
dab_target_mean.description: Mean target DAB optical density. A reference summary, not a model-performance ranking.

rmse.label: RMSE
rmse.description: Root mean squared RGB error. Larger local errors receive more weight than in MAE.

mse.label: MSE
mse.description: Mean squared RGB error on a 0–1 scale.

ms_ssim.label: MS-SSIM
ms_ssim.description: Structural similarity at multiple image scales. Higher is better. Scale weights and implementation belong to the recorded protocol.

pearson_rgb.label: RGB Pearson
pearson_rgb.description: Paired RGB intensity correlation, averaged over valid channels. Constant channels can be undefined; valid coverage is reported.

dists.label: DISTS
dists.description: Deep Image Structure and Texture Similarity. Lower indicates greater similarity of learned structure and texture. Not a diagnostic validation.

fid_clean.label: FID clean
fid_clean.description: Fréchet Inception Distance between generated and real image feature distributions under clean-fid preprocessing. Unpaired distribution similarity, not paired tissue fidelity. Small cohorts can bias estimates.

kid_clean.label: KID clean
kid_clean.description: Kernel Inception Distance under clean-fid preprocessing. Raw unbiased MMD², not multiplied by 1000; values can be negative. Compare only identical sampling protocols.

scm.label: SCM
scm.description: Structural component of the configured Gaussian SSIM calculation. Emphasizes paired local structure; distinct from complete SSIM.

ssim_gaussian.label: SSIM Gaussian
ssim_gaussian.description: SSIM using the recorded Gaussian-window protocol. Keep separate from box-window and scikit-image SSIM.

ssim_skimage.label: SSIM skimage
ssim_skimage.description: Scikit-image SSIM under the recorded evaluator settings. Keep separate from box-window SSIM.

hematoxylin_od_mae.label: H stain MAE
hematoxylin_od_mae.description: Paired hematoxylin optical-density error after fixed colour deconvolution. Lower indicates closer stain intensity.

eosin_od_mae.label: E stain MAE
eosin_od_mae.description: Paired eosin optical-density error after fixed colour deconvolution. Lower indicates closer stain intensity.

nuclei_f1.label: Nuclei F1
nuclei_f1.description: Harmonic mean of precision and recall for spatially matched automatic nuclei. Reference labels are detector outputs on real H&E, not manual annotations.

nuclei_precision.label: Nuclei precision
nuclei_precision.description: Fraction of predicted automatic nuclei that match real-H&E detections within the fixed matching radius.

nuclei_recall.label: Nuclei recall
nuclei_recall.description: Fraction of real-H&E automatic detections recovered at matching locations in the prediction.

nuclei_mask_dice.label: Nuclei Dice
nuclei_mask_dice.description: Dice overlap of automatic nuclear foreground masks. Real-H&E detector masks are pseudo-reference labels.

nuclei_mask_iou.label: Nuclei IoU
nuclei_mask_iou.description: Intersection over union of automatic nuclear foreground masks. Higher means more spatial overlap.

nuclei_count_abs_error.label: Nuclei count error
nuclei_count_abs_error.description: Absolute difference in automatic nuclear counts per tile. Correct counts can still accompany incorrect locations.

nuclei_area_wasserstein_px2.label: Nuclei area W₁
nuclei_area_wasserstein_px2.description: Wasserstein distance between detected nuclear area distributions. Pixel units depend on tissue resolution.

nuclei_eccentricity_wasserstein.label: Nuclei shape W₁
nuclei_eccentricity_wasserstein.description: Wasserstein distance between detected nuclear eccentricity distributions. Lower means closer shape distributions.

loss.label: Objective loss
loss.description: The objective used by this training recipe. Different recipes, weights and objectives have different scales; compare its trend within a run.

training_hours.label: Training time
training_hours.description: Recorded training-job wall time, including setup, validation and I/O as specified per run. Parent training and continuation segments may be excluded. A compute comparison, not an accuracy score.

gpu_hours.label: GPU allocation
gpu_hours.description: Wall time multiplied by allocated GPUs. Allocated compute, not measured kernel utilization. Follow each run’s recorded time definition.

cellpose_sam_area_w1.description: Wasserstein distance between automatic nuclear area distributions, measured in original crop pixel². Depends on detector and tissue resolution.

cellpose_sam_count_mae.label: Cellpose-SAM count MAE
cellpose_sam_count_mae.description: Additional recorded diagnostic. Read its run protocol and sample coverage before interpreting or comparing.

watershed_micro_f1.description: F1 from pooled true-positive, false-positive and false-negative automatic nuclear matches across all pilot patches. Real-H&E detector outputs are pseudo-reference labels. Typed F1 also requires matching predicted nuclear class.

watershed_shape_w1.label: Watershed shape W1
watershed_shape_w1.description: Wasserstein distance between the eccentricity distributions of automatically detected nuclei. Lower means more similar detected shapes.

world_size.label: World Size
